text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-2026-314 fired: SEV2 - inference-queue-depth-high (us-west-2). queue_depth > 5000 for 3m. paging rotation: olivia -> devon -> kevin. link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-2026-314
kevin: acked on PD, I'm on it
olivia: on-call, jumping in — getting basics: what services impacted?
devon: seeing high pending requests on inference-dispatcher, latency 2.4s -> 9s, 502s starting to creep up. autoscaler hasn't increased replicas in last 12m
maria: adding logs: dispatcher's backlog metric shows steady rise, kv-cache warmup failing for new replicas, errors: "failed to attach replica: node quota exceeded"
kevin: hmm autoscaler events show repeated scale up attempts then failures. paste: ```kubectl describe hpa inference-dispatcher -n prod
Events:
  Type    Reason             Age   From                       Message
  ----    ------             ----  ----                       -------
  Normal  SuccessfulRescale  12m   horizontal-pod-autoscaler  New size: 3; reason: CPU above target
  Warning  FailedScale       11m   cluster-autoscaler          failed to provision nodes: quota exceeded
```
olivia: confirmed, autoscaler requested nodes but cloud account hit instance quota. infra-team, can we get a short burst quota increase? @infra-team
infra-team: looking. quota shows x3 of spot limit hit in us-west-2, can approve a temporary +50% for 10m, doing now.
devon: while infra pushes quota, manual mitigation: we can scale up deployment to drain backlog from pods that are healthy. proposing `kubectl scale deploy/inference-dispatcher --replicas=12 -n prod` (if nodes available). anyone object?
maria: if nodes not available, extra pods will stay pending and won't help. but we can increase concurrency on existing workers: bump `WORKER_THREADS` env to 64 for hotpath, will improve throughput per pod.
kevin: plan: 1) infra try quota bump 2) if nodes still pending in 2m, increase WORKER_THREADS and temporarily set HPA max to 12, 3) manual scale to 12 if nodes appear. executing step 2 now (rolling update)
olivia: paste command for threads bump: ```kubectl set env deployment/inference-dispatcher WORKER_THREADS=64 -n prod```
devon: running it now. rolling update started. watching pods restart.
kevin: infra updated quota, cloud reports new instances can be provisioned, but spot capacity is thin. cluster-autoscaler logs show provisioning throttled due to gp2 quota.
maria: rolled update completed on 4/6 pods so far, throughput per pod up ~2x, backlog growth stopped. queue depth peaked at 6200 now trending down to 4200.
olivia: customer impact assessment: visible increased latency and some 502s for API consumers on hosted plans for ~18m. tentative impact: increased tail latency, degraded throughput; errors ~0.15% of requests.
kevin: notify support: "We have elevated error rates and latency on text generation in us-west-2. Mitigation underway: increase worker concurrency and request temporary cloud quota. We expect recovery in ~10-20m."
devon: sending update to #support: "PD-2026-314: Automated paging triggered for inference queue backlog. Mitigations: concurrency bump rolled, infra quota request in flight. ETA next update ~10m." :wave:
kevin: manual scale attempt now — nodes are coming up, kubectl scale to 8 replicas (safe intermediate). `kubectl scale deploy/inference-dispatcher --replicas=8 -n prod`
maria: pods scheduling, new pods initializing, kv-cache warmup still slow for new pods, but concurrency bump helped existing ones pull more work.
devon: metrics: queue_depth 4200 -> 2100 over 6m. error rate trending down. partially recovered.
olivia: good. create post-incident ticket: link to logs, timeline, and hypothesis (node quota + cold start kvcache). I'll tag reliability for a follow-up on autoscaler/backoff logic.
kevin: adding runbook notes: consider adding a fast-path that temporarily increases worker threads on sustained queue growth so we don't rely solely on node provisioning. Also consider reserve capacity for peak windows.
infra-team: confirmed temporary quota increased and then revoked after 15m once stable. we recommend a permanent quota request; filing internal ticket Q-7892.
maria: final numbers: peak queue 6.2k, peak pending pods 9, time to half-backlog after mitigation ~8m, customer errors peaked at 0.17%.
devon: PD update: annotate incident as "Mitigated - manual concurrency + quota bump". leaving PD in-ack state for follow-up tomorrow.
olivia: handoff note for next oncall (tomorrow morning): keep monitoring queue_depth, check HPA events for repeated FailedScale reasons, follow infra ticket Q-7892 for quota increase, check kvcache warmup perf for new replicas.
kevin: thanks everyone. closing thread here, leaving PD incident open for postmortem. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: PD-2026-314 annotated: mitigated; responders: olivia, devon, kevin, maria, infra-team.
